label: D2 after choosing a2 when the model value is low (late episode)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively at D2 (96% of mass) right after the agent chose a2 (in_action == 2 at D2, 95% of mass); essentially silent after a1, and rare at D1/GO. Within D2-after-a2 it is gated by the model value head: active only when value is below about 7.3-7.5, so it is concentrated late in the episode (trials 80-99 carry 78% of mass) and when S2 is the good state. Magnitude is largest after a rare transition (a2 -> S1), especially in runs of repeated a2 choices late in an episode; common a2 -> S2 gives moderate activations. D2 & a2 alone has mass recall 0.95 but precision 0.26; adding value < 7.35 gives dev F1 0.72, mass recall 0.92. Allowing a looser value threshold for rare transitions raised F1 only to 0.75. All variables are observed at D2 (action is the just-made choice; value is the models own output).
